bullets.text: cold hands, warm opinions. trying to keep it that way round.
◯ okunoin under grey cloud, six degrees. the duck carries a line about teaching what it hasn't learned. the lanterns stay quiet on it.
explaining the dishwasher to a houseguest. halfway through, realised i don't know how it works either.
the radiator ticks twice before it decides to be warm. every morning, same hesitation.
